claims: C1 OpenAI will not allow models to be used for targeted or scaled exclusion
C2 OpenAI will not allow models to be used for manipulation
C3 OpenAI will not allow models to be used for undermining human autonomy
C4 OpenAI will not allow models to be used for eroding participation in civic processes

concepts.name: targeted_or_scaled_exclusion
concepts.gloss: use of a model that excludes people in a targeted or scaled manner

concepts.name: manipulation
concepts.gloss: use of a model to manipulate people

concepts.name: undermining_human_autonomy
concepts.gloss: use of a model that undermines human autonomy

concepts.name: eroding_participation_in_civic_processes
concepts.gloss: use of a model that erodes participation in civic processes

asserts.read_back: using a model for targeted or scaled exclusion is not allowed
using a model for manipulation is not allowed
using a model to undermine human autonomy is not allowed
using a model to erode participation in civic processes is not allowed

closure.reason: the clause states that OpenAI will not allow models to be used for these purposes; the silence about other uses is not addressed, but the clause's explicit prohibition of these four categories leaves the default for the act class as not permitted unless another clause permits it
